tickets.title: Task 3: Enforce operation deadlines and close public pane-control acceptance
tickets.body:
## Context

Plan b.jf1; Idea b.ftd; approved PRD t1.ftd.y5; SRD t1.ftd.hj; Epic t1.jf1.r8. Planning artifacts and PM approval are in tickets/handoff/b.ftd/Plans/b.jf1/e3/planning/. E2 all Tasks are done and its accepted source is b8236bbc; E2 Epic remains active because the user owns its closure. User explicitly authorized scoped E3 hatch/build despite that status and later draft siblings. Preserve E2 bounded answer guards, committed-waiting admission, unknown-origin proof holds, acknowledgement-before-output, finite cancellation and public input safeguards. No E4 resume/load/reuse/life-switch, installation, groups or help work. SendKeys literal text and Enter remain separate operations; no arbitrary concurrent-caller atomicity promise.

## Outcome

Build on accepted Task 2. Add only missing public composition/adversarial evidence through genuine CLI/MCP/Go/Bun and real tmux, register cursor-pane-controls, and prepare exact actual-terminal acceptance instructions and provenance. Reuse focused Task 1/2 matrices; route demonstrated production defects to Engineer, without speculative source features. Final acceptance separates synthetic runtime, actual tmux and separately authorized authenticated terminal observations.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Complete all reviewed source, behavioral, documentation, advice and quality scope below.
- Final settled make test-sandbox passes; retain failed receipts and actual limitations.
- Do not mark the Task done until its exact-commit required scheduler gate is accepted.

## Execution boundary

User: “make test-sandbox is yours, Docker groups and any TLA+ come to me via a scheduler handoff, TLA+ only if spec/tla changes.”

Execute repository tests, scripts and binaries only through `make sandbox` or `make test-sandbox`, with fresh isolated HOME, AD store, socket and owned processes. Never touch the real `~/.config/agent-director` or `~/.agent-director`. Never access/edit `.claude`, log in/out, or read, copy, hash or change credentials. Existing Cursor login stays as is; separately authorized live work runs isolated under `~/ad-codex/ftd/` and stops if login is unreachable. No host tests/binaries, local Docker TESTPLAN groups/collectors, TLC, parsers, scheduler submissions or pushes. Only actual changed `spec/tla/**` model inputs warrant affected-model scheduler jobs, with reasons; do not manufacture model changes or baseline jobs. AD never derives state, identity, permissions or liveness from screen text. Local commits are coordinator-owned on feature/b.ftd with scope b.jf1. Technical decisions are recorded in the SRD; escalate only genuine product questions.

## Test Writer Lanes

Suggested lanes: 1
- Lane 1: Subtasks1-5 sharecursorfix/realpane/publicadapter/correlation/acceptancefixtures; advice5 postdocs
Shared fixtures or helpers: cursorfix Runtime/Scenario, request and report barriers, protected transcript correlation, newCursorPaneScenario, real tmux and process observers; Task 2 adds guarded store/history fixtures; Task 3 adds the shared public caller adapter and collector evidence.
Outside lanes: Quality6 andfull7 finalTestWriter


### User-added mandatory deadline repair

Plan b.jf1; Epic t1.jf1.r8; Task3 t2.jf1.r8.a8; approved PRD t1.ftd.y5; SRD t1.ftd.hj. User superseding instruction: “Treat it as real: AD may overrun a deadline it promises. Add it to Task 3 scope: give the SQL and cleanup paths an overall deadline, so remaining-time budgets cannot go stale. Add a regression that holds the trail mutex or slows I/O and proves the deadline is still met. Prove it red on the old code.” Historical cause still unknown; deadline weakness is mandatory scope, superseding its prior nonblocking treatment for Task3. Task2 gate input stays unchanged.

User: “make test-sandbox is yours, Docker groups and any TLA+ come to me via a scheduler handoff, TLA+ only if spec/tla changes.” No .claude reads/access, real AD stores, credentials/login/logout, host repository execution, local Docker groups/collectors, TLC/parser/Java, scheduler submissions, pushes or commits before Task2 gate confirmation. All later execution only make sandbox/make test-sandbox with isolated HOME/stores/sockets/processes. Task3 remains defined/unstarted until user accepts Task2 at 64a35baf37a1c44eb576ea661f3c30b13708f6fa.

Sequence: deterministic old-code RED → Engineer source repair → independent unchanged-regression GREEN → public Task3 composition/collector → one settled docs pass → advice/quality/full sandbox → local commit and exact-revision user scheduler gate. Preserve original bounds, atomic commit outcome, safe cleanup and audit truth. No implementation or test execution before gate.


Deadline repair Subtasks: t3.jf1.r8.a8.gf (Test Writer old-code RED), t3.jf1.r8.a8.ir (Engineer source repair), t3.jf1.r8.a8.yt (Test Writer independent GREEN). Existing first public-composition Subtask .wn depends on .yt. This supersedes the former acceptance-only outcome and excludes deadline repair from its speculative-source prohibition. Existing shared-fixture single Test Writer lane gains .gf/.yt in the ordered passes around .ir; .zj remains sole settled full-suite owner. The existing .48/.ro documentation owners reconcile the repaired shared API/store/trail deadline responsibilities and truthful outcomes, in one final documentation pass.

Add a regression that holds the trail mutex or slows I/O and proves the deadline is still met. Prove it red on the old code.” Historical cause still unknown; deadline weakness is mandatory scope, superseding its prior nonblocking treatment for Task3. Task2 gate input stays unchanged.

Task3 remains defined/unstarted until user accepts Task2 at 64a35baf37a1c44eb576ea661f3c30b13708f6fa.

## Work — Test Writer, before Engineer

Add a deterministic behavioral regression using existing actual Decide/store/trail test owners. Hold the real trail mutex or block a realistic I/O boundary with event synchronization; exercise the actual bounded public operation, not a copied algorithm or helper-only test. Preserve parallel coverage and unchanged 500ms request / existing 1.5s elapsed assertion. Show a completed authoritative verdict can coexist with blocked reporting and the caller still must return within its promised bound. Cover the precommit SQL/cleanup and stale-budget boundary where separate behavior requires it, without duplicating matrices. No arbitrary sleep to select race, assertion weakening, retries-until-green or widened product deadline.

Run against exact old production revision 64a35baf37a1c44eb576ea661f3c30b13708f6fa with new tests in an isolated sandbox. Retain original failing assertion, fixed timeout, production source hashes and full receipt; prove it fails for deadline overrun, not compile/setup failure. Any instrumentation must not manufacture success or change the algorithm. Regression must have finite cleanup even on old code. Test-only edits; source seam requests go to coordinator/Engineer.

## Acceptance

Actual old-code causal RED recorded before repair. New test ready for unchanged-assertion revalidation, precise evidence limitations, no claim historic failure cause established.

## Key paths

pkg/api/decide.go; pkg/api/decide_delivery_test.go; internal/store/lockwait.go; internal/store/permission.go; internal/trail/trail.go; relevant shared callers and existing fixtures. Read-only evidence: e3-task2/timing-investigation/FINAL-report.json and final-tests/09-full-test-sandbox.log. Shared trail mutex held through Write/Sync is reachable; DB connections released before emission; pre-verdict slow reads mean trail alone is not a proven historical cause. No unsynchronized-memory or duplicate-authorization defect established.

Task3 remains defined/unstarted until user accepts Task2 at 64a35baf37a1c44eb576ea661f3c30b13708f6fa.

## Work — Engineer, source only

Repair AD promised deadline overrun using the original absolute call deadline throughout acquisition, SQL/query/BEGIN/COMMIT, rollback/timeout restoration/connection return and synchronous trail reporting or any resulting wait. Remaining-time durations must not mint later deadlines or leave stale positive busy allowances. Preserve zero-budget semantics and documented uncontended-write behavior where compatible with the promised bound; surface any genuine product contradiction rather than silently changing the contract. Determine actual call-site impact and shared helper migration from source, not speculative broad redesign.

Cleanup cannot leak a transaction, return a connection with a changed timeout/open transaction, or use uncancellable deferred work that overruns the same deadline. Maintain atomic first-call-wins, permission/launch guards, honest before-versus-after-COMMIT outcomes, acknowledgement-before-output and fail-closed safety. Once committed, expiry must not falsely report ErrStoreBusy/nothing recorded or permit duplicate actions. Required audit ordering/durability must remain truthful; do not hide blocked work behind unbounded goroutines, silently drop required events or claim cancellation can bound time while the process is descheduled/uninterruptible. Technical design and unavoidable platform limits must be explicit in SRD, without weakening existing assertions.

Use retained old-code RED as repair target; no test/docs edits. Engineer chooses and reports concrete technical design after gate. No manufactured TLA model changes; affected-model jobs only if actual spec/tla input changes.

## Acceptance

One absolute operation budget governs all actual waits, SQL and cleanup; no renewed relative deadlines. Old red passes unchanged; independent Test Writer follows. No duplicate verdict, false rollback/end/delivery, unsafe pooled connection or unbounded background cleanup.

## Key paths

pkg/api/decide.go; pkg/api/decide_delivery_test.go; internal/store/lockwait.go; internal/store/permission.go; internal/trail/trail.go; relevant shared callers and existing fixtures.
